blocks.text: The Device Investigation Details drawer (Analytics > Endpoint Data Scan > Device Investigation > click an endpoint name) displays details for the device you select on the Device Investigation page. The drawer shows all the details from the device's perspective.
The following sections are available in the drawer:

blocks.item: 1. Overall Totals
This section consists of the following widgets:
Endpoint Health: Shows the overall health of the endpoint.
Applications: Shows the total number of applications installed on the endpoint, categorized as suspicious and malicious applications.
Sensitive Files Discovered: Shows the number of sensitive files discovered on the endpoint from the last scan. The scan is performed every day.
2. Overview
This tab shows general information about the endpoint, such as:
Device ID
Last Logged on User
Last Updated time
Operating System
OS Build
Zscaler Client Connector Version
Endpoint DLP Version
Endpoint DLP Installation Time
Endpoint DLP Status
Endpoint DLP Mode
Endpoint DLP Policy Version
Device Control Policy Version
Endpoint Data Scan Status
Nearby Sharing Status
Anti-Tampering Status
3. Applications
This tab shows the applications that are running on the endpoint you selected for investigation from the following perspectives:
Filter the data shown in this tab by Product Name, Code Signing, Threat Type, or Application Name.
The table shows the following information for each application:
Application Name: Name of the application.
Product Name: Product name associated with the application.
Code Signing: Shows if the code sign is a Valid Signature, Unsigned, Certificate Expired, or Invalid Signature.
Threat Type: Displays the threat type of the application, such as Benign, Malicious, Suspicious, or Unknown.
4. Sensitive Files Discovered
This tab shows sensitive file details discovered on the endpoint from the following perspectives:
Number of sensitive files found: You can monitor the 30-day trend of sensitive data stored on each endpoint.
Top Sensitive Data:
DLP Engines: The number of sensitive files discovered for the DLP engines category on the endpoints. Click View All to view the detailed list of sensitive files.
AI & ML Categories: The number of sensitive files discovered for the AI & ML categories on the endpoints. Click View All to view the detailed list of sensitive files.
Distribution by File Type: The number of sensitive files discovered by the file type (e.g., PDF, TXT, ZIP). Click View All to view the detailed list of sensitive files.
Export: You can export the details of the sensitive file discovered in a CSV format.
Top Sensitive Files Discovered: This table shows all the sensitive files discovered on the endpoints. For each file, you can view:
File Name: The name of the file.
File Size: The file size.
DLP Engines: The DLP engines that the file triggered.
AI & ML Categories: The AL & ML categories under which the file is classified.
Path: The path where the file is stored on the endpoint.
Dictionaries: The list of DLP dictionaries triggered by the file.
File Type: The file type (TXT, ZIP, DOCX).
SHA-256: The unique and irreversible hash of the file used for cryptographic security.
Customize Columns (): Rearrange the columns and search for column names on the page.
5. Add Filters

You can add filters by clicking the plus icon. The available options are as follows: Error Type, Last Connected, Endpoint DLP Version, Endpoint DLP Policy Version, Device Control Policy Version, Endpoint DLP Mode, Zscaler Client Connector Version, or Anti-Tampering Status.
